paragraphs.text: Glass can be recycled again and again without losing quality, yet in many countries less than half of all glass bottles are collected. Recycling saves energy, because crushed glass melts at a lower temperature than the raw materials used to make new glass.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: At a typical recycling plant, collected glass is first sorted by colour, since clear, green and brown glass cannot be mixed if the new bottles are to keep their colour. Workers and machines then remove paper labels, metal caps and other contamination. Even a small piece of ceramic, such as a broken cup, can create a weak spot in a new bottle.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: The clean glass is crushed into small pieces known as cullet. The cullet is mixed with sand, soda ash and limestone and heated in a furnace to around 1,500 degrees Celsius. The molten glass is then poured into moulds, where air is blown in to form the shape of the bottle. Finally, the new bottles are cooled slowly so that they do not crack.
paragraphs.label: C

items.quote: collected glass is first sorted by colour

explanation.en: “first sorted by colour” → colour (American “color” is also accepted). “Clear, green and brown” are examples, not the answer.
explanation.kk: «first sorted by colour» → colour (американдық color да есептеледі). «Clear, green and brown» — түстердің мысалы, жауап емес.
explanation.ru: «first sorted by colour» → colour (американское color тоже засчитывается). «Clear, green and brown» — примеры цветов, не ответ.

items.quote: remove paper labels, metal caps and other contamination
items.prompt: Labels, caps and other 2 ____ are removed

explanation.en: “remove paper labels, metal caps and other contamination” → contamination. “Ceramic” in the next sentence is one example; the chart needs the general word after “other”.
explanation.kk: «remove paper labels, metal caps and other contamination» → contamination. Келесі сөйлемдегі «ceramic» — ластаудың бір мысалы, ал схемада «other» сөзінен кейінгі жалпы сөз керек.
explanation.ru: «remove paper labels, metal caps and other contamination» → contamination. «Ceramic» в следующем предложении — пример загрязнения, а в схеме нужно общее слово после «other».

items.quote: crushed into small pieces known as cullet
items.prompt: Glass is crushed into pieces called 3 ____

explanation.en: “crushed into small pieces known as cullet” → cullet. “Called” in the chart = “known as” in the text. Copy an unfamiliar word exactly.
explanation.kk: «crushed into small pieces known as cullet» → cullet. Схемадағы «called» = мәтіндегі «known as». Бейтаныс сөзді дәл көшіреміз.
explanation.ru: «crushed into small pieces known as cullet» → cullet. «Called» в схеме = «known as» в тексте. Незнакомое слово переписываем точно.

items.quote: heated in a furnace to around 1,500 degrees Celsius
items.prompt: Cullet is heated with sand, soda ash and limestone in a 4 ____

explanation.en: “heated in a furnace to around 1,500 degrees” → furnace. After “in a” we need a place, not a temperature: “1,500 degrees” fits neither the meaning nor the limit.
explanation.kk: «heated in a furnace to around 1,500 degrees» → furnace. «in a» сөзінен кейін температура емес, орын керек: «1,500 degrees» мағынасы жағынан да, шек жағынан да келмейді.
explanation.ru: «heated in a furnace to around 1,500 degrees» → furnace. После «in a» нужно место, а не температура: «1,500 degrees» не подходит ни по смыслу, ни по лимиту.

items.quote: the new bottles are cooled slowly so that they do not crack
items.prompt: New bottles are 5 ____ slowly to prevent cracking

explanation.en: “the new bottles are cooled slowly so that they do not crack” → cooled. The verb form from the text fits “are … slowly” unchanged.
explanation.kk: «the new bottles are cooled slowly so that they do not crack» → cooled. Мәтіндегі етістік түрі «are … slowly» тіркесіне өзгеріссіз сай келеді.
explanation.ru: «the new bottles are cooled slowly so that they do not crack» → cooled. Форма глагола из текста подходит к «are … slowly» без изменений.

steps: Labels, caps and other 2 ____ are removed
Glass is crushed into pieces called 3 ____
Cullet is heated with sand, soda ash and limestone in a 4 ____
Molten glass is shaped in moulds
New bottles are 5 ____ slowly to prevent cracking
